description.value: Silver Star Motel is a budget-friendly motel in Vernon, BC, well-positioned for access to Silver Star Mountain ski area, Okanagan wine country, and local golf courses. The property offers a range of room types including kitchenette suites and pet-friendly options, with free on-site parking. Guests receive discount cards for several nearby restaurants, and fast food and coffee are within a two-minute walk.

address.value: 3700 32nd Street, Vernon, British Columbia, Canada V1T 5N6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich, confirming the motel is open and operating in Vernon, BC. Contact details (phone, address, email) on the website exactly match OSM tags. No mention of bike storage, laundry, or cycle-specific facilities anywhere on the site; however, the /amenities page confirms free WiFi, the /rooms page confirms in-room charging stations, and the /dining page confirms multiple restaurants immediately adjacent to the property.
concerns: Website footer shows copyright © 2020 and a prominent COVID-19 notice banner, suggesting the site has not been updated recently. Core contact details still appear valid but amenity details may be stale.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel with an active website and confirmed contact details. Useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Vernon/Okanagan area.

Nearby evening food.detail: Boston Pizza is directly next door; Kelly O'Bryans and White Spot are also nearby; multiple full-service restaurants listed on the /dining page within walking distance

Device charging.detail: Rooms page lists 'Charging stations' as a standard in-room amenity in all room types

wow_evidence: budget-friendly motel in Vernon, BC, well-positioned for access to Silver Star Mountain ski area, Okanagan wine country
